title: Saul Meets Jesus
summary: Saul Meets Jesus follows a real Bible moment about grace. Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission. When someone seems too mean or too far gone to change, Saul's story reminds kids that Jesus can interrupt a life and remake it.

read_it.prompt: Read Acts 9:1-19 slowly and listen for the choice, promise, warning, or rescue in the story.

tell_it: Jesus stopped Saul on the road and gave him a new direction. In the story, Saul was going to hurt believers, but Jesus stopped him on the road. Saul became a servant of Jesus.
understand_it: Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission. Saul Meets Jesus also shows that grace has a shape in real life, not only in Bible vocabulary.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus stopped Saul on the road and gave him a new direction.
age_8_11_explanation: Saul was going to hurt believers, but Jesus stopped him on the road. Saul became a servant of Jesus. Ages 8-11 can name the Bible detail in Saul Meets Jesus and the takeaway: Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission.
teen_explanation: Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission. For teens, the lesson is worth discussing honestly because it connects belief with public choices, private motives, and costly obedience.
key_truths: Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission.
Saul Meets Jesus shows grace through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When someone seems too mean or too far gone to change, Saul's story reminds kids that Jesus can interrupt a life and remake it.
life_application: When someone seems too mean or too far gone to change, Saul's story reminds kids that Jesus can interrupt a life and remake it.

quiz_questions.question: In this lesson about grace, which answer matches the Bible story?
choices: Saul kept hurting believers after meeting Jesus
Saul was looking for a church picnic
Ananias changed Saul by his own power
quiz_questions.explanation: Jesus fits the actual event in Saul Meets Jesus. The wrong answers may sound possible in another story, but not this one.

quiz_questions.question: Which response best fits the lesson's point?
choices: Pretend the hard part in Saul Meets Jesus is not hard.
Use Saul Meets Jesus only to win a trivia point.
Ignore what God shows in Saul Meets Jesus.
When someone seems too mean or too far gone to change, Saul's story reminds kids that Jesus can interrupt a life and remake it.
quiz_questions.answer: When someone seems too mean or too far gone to change, Saul's story reminds kids that Jesus can interrupt a life and remake it.
quiz_questions.explanation: A useful Bible lesson changes how we see a real choice. Jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission.

memory_verse.prompt: Practice Acts 9:5 and listen for how it supports the lesson's grace theme.

discussion_questions: Retell Saul Meets Jesus in three beats: setup, hard moment, and response.
Which detail keeps Saul Meets Jesus from becoming just a generic moral?
Where might Saul Meets Jesus help at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Changed Direction Road
activity.instructions: Draw a road with one arrow going the wrong way and another toward Jesus, then name what changed for Saul.

prayer_prompt: God, show me where Saul Meets Jesus touches my own life, and help me respond with honesty, courage, and obedience.
